title: The Lizard on the Rail
summary: Allen mentions the tune's original name; Steinau's mother sang a fragment and Johnny Wiggs played it.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You still haven't talked about the thing originally entitled the Hiawatha, the Indian and a Mezzo. Do you know what that is? No. That's the original name of the The Lizard on the Rail. Oh really? Yeah, and Tony Perrini recorded it. I thought I would have played that for

it. No. I think I did hear the Perrini record. And Johnny used to play it, Johnny Wiggs. Yeah, well my mother used to, and I don't quite know where she picked it up from, but she used to sometimes sing a very brief business about there's a lizard on the rail, on the rail, on the rail, with his tail coupe. And is that how it goes in the...
Well I think Johnny sang it as, with his tail cut off, but exactly the same. Hmm. Johnny Wiggs. No, I'd forgotten that. Wiggs. Which is another old circuit.
